pages.title: Six voices, arranged
text: A [Pulse Resonator](pulse_resonator) counts at most **five** voices from a loose heap of totems, Kinship Totems included. To count all six elements plus kinship, the voices have to be **arranged**.

The Voice Ring is eight slots around the Resonator, **three blocks** out on the cardinals and the diagonals, all on the Resonator's own level. Eight, because six evenly spaced totems do not fit on a square grid.

pages.title: The ring
pages.text: A totem in every one of the eight slots, three blocks from the Resonator.

pages.title: Filling the ring
text: Every slot needs a totem, but only **distinct** voices count, the sixth included. Two Earth totems are still one voice, so spare slots can hold duplicates.
Only **Answered** totems count; a quiet one has to be woken first (see [Keeping](keeping)).
Seat the catalyst as usual. Crouch and right-click the Resonator with the Codex to see ghosts of missing slots and the voice count.
